reason: A browser-only, read-only UI plugin that visualizes DeepSeek Harness sessions, subagents, and durable workflows as a navigable task dependency graph.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中将会话、子代理和持久化工作流展示为可导航的实时任务依赖图。
summaries.en: Visualizes DeepSeek Harness Web sessions, subagents, and durable workflows as a navigable live task dependency graph.

capabilities: Displays a live DAG of sessions, delegated subagents, and durable workflows
Reads client-side session and workflow projections for visualization
Provides session navigation for available subagent sessions
Supports graph fitting, panning, node dragging, and catalog refresh
